start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:keep-where-the-person-stands-on-a-record with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_shop on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-shop-postgres-connection\"} and stands [{\"record\": \"message:m1\", \"stance\": \"agree\", \"answered_by\": \"person\"}]."
no_lists_because: It names no list: the stands are kept in the person's own store, in whatever form that store keeps things, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:keep-where-the-person-stands-on-a-record" with store and the stands to keep. Ask the person first, and send answered_by "person" only with what they said.
3. The first run makes the store's own objects once and proves them on the example attempts: every attempt must be kept, repeated or refused as the intent says, or the run stops and says which.
4. Every later run keeps the new stands through those objects and reads each one back. A disagreement with a decision opens it for a corrected one and gives one AI its task, once.

worked_examples.title: A message agreed with, then taken back
worked_examples.ask: I agree with the message m1. Actually take that back.

store.where: postgresql database example_shop on my own computer

worked_examples.given: The look step found the stands kept in the store's own objects, made by an earlier run.
